Check: Replica data lag (minutes) within DATA_LAG critical limit
Why: Stale replica = every alert is stale (data-replica-latency skill)
What_To_Do: Newest warehouse transaction is too old. If the site is live: ask iDecide to check the replica feed (HVR). If the site is not live yet: expected - wait for go-live.

Check: Model refreshed within the last 24 hours
Why: Scheduled refresh / credentials broken
What_To_Do: The report did not refresh in 24 h. Workspace > model > Refresh history: read the error; usually the gateway connection or its sign-in.

Check: TTAT feed has trucks in the last 7 days
Why: TTAT query returns nothing - check trlr_cod / actcod codes for the site
What_To_Do: No truck check-in in the last days. Live site: confirm with the dock that trucks were checked in in the WMS. Not live: expected.

Check: Location feed loaded (usable storage locations)
Why: Location utilisation query failed or no usable locations
What_To_Do: No storage locations loaded - the location query or warehouse ID is wrong. Run the site profiler and correct the Sites tab.

Check: User activity feed loaded (last N days)
Why: dlytrn user activity query returned nothing
What_To_Do: No RF scans by users in the last days. Live site: check the warehouse ID in the Sites tab. Not live: expected.

Check: Production feed has pallets in the look-back window
Why: LTA production query returns nothing - check LOC_LTA / FG_PRTNUM_LIKE tokens
What_To_Do: No pallets taken from the production lines. Lines stopped, or the line hand-off locations are set wrong: confirm with production, then the line map.

Check: No negative TTAT (dispatch before check-in)
Why: Same rule as Excel VALIDATION #20
What_To_Do: Some trucks were closed before check-in - a WMS data-entry error. Correct the truck times in the WMS.

Check: No GR time longer than total turnaround
Why: Same rule as Excel VALIDATION #22
What_To_Do: Some goods receipts take longer than the whole truck visit - WMS times are wrong. Correct them in the WMS.

Check: No negative pallet counts in production feed
Why: Same rule as Excel VALIDATION #9
What_To_Do: Negative pallet counts in production - reversals in the WMS. Check the listed reversals with production.

Check: No blank report dates in production feed
Why: Same rule as Excel VALIDATION #7
What_To_Do: Production rows without a date - check the production query.

Check: All production hours within 0-23
Why: Same rule as Excel VALIDATION #11
What_To_Do: Production rows with an impossible hour - check the time zone in the Sites tab.

Check: No UNMAPPED takeaway lines (Cfg_LineMap complete)
Why: Add the missing LTA source to config/line_map.csv
What_To_Do: Pallets come from a line that is not in the line map - add it in config/line_map.csv.

Check: Exactly one site selected in the Site slicer
Why: Pick one site in the banner Site slicer - KPIs are per site
What_To_Do: Pick exactly one site in the Site box at the top.

Check: Every KPI has a threshold row
Why: config/kpi_thresholds.csv must keep the default (*) rows
What_To_Do: Default targets are missing - restore the 'All sites' rows in the inputs file, tab Alert targets.

Check: Production data lag vs clock (hours)
Why: Excel VALIDATION - production data lagging the clock
What_To_Do: Production data stops hours before now - lines stopped or the feed is late. Confirm with production; then check the replica lag.

Check: Replica of the selected site loaded at the last refresh (Data Health rows)
Why: Site partitions empty - check the replica connection / credentials of this site, then Refresh
What_To_Do: Nothing loaded for this site - refresh failed for its replica. Workspace > Refresh history; check the gateway connection.

Check: Every line seen in the production feed is in Cfg_LineMap
Why: Cfg_LineMap has no row for this site
What_To_Do: The site has no production lines in the line map - add them in config/line_map.csv.

Check: Replica keeps enough transaction history for the look-back views (days)
Why: Replica retention differs per site - fewer days means past-day filters show 'not in replica' (check site_config_check.py)
What_To_Do: The replica holds less than a week of history: a new (or not yet live) site. Past-day views stay short until history builds up - nothing to fix.

Check: Outbound truck feed has trucks closed in the last FORECAST_DAYS days (Excel VALIDATION 29 / 31)
Why: No outbound truck closed recently - outbound TTAT alerts read an old day (or the site ships nothing yet)
What_To_Do: No outbound truck closed recently - outbound turnaround alerts look at an old day. Live site: confirm shipments with the dock. Not live: expected.

Check: Inbound and outbound truck feeds reach the same day (Excel VALIDATION 36)
Why: One truck feed lags the other - the inbound and outbound TTAT alerts compare different days
What_To_Do: Inbound and outbound truck data end on different days - one feed is late. Re-check after the next refresh; if it stays, report owner checks the truck queries.
